_comment: Fixed translations that override MADLAD. Section key: "<source>-><target>" or just "<target>" (any source). A term matches only when it is the whole input, a whole line, a heading label or one translation unit of a line (case-insensitive, trailing punctuation ignored). Edits are picked up without restarting.
_comment_labels: Heading labels ('テーマ：…'). Alone, MADLAD reads テーマ as 'Sắc thái' and 'テーマ：X' as the wiki namespace 'Bản mẫu:X'.
